title: Dynatrace MCP Server workflow template injection via create_workflow_for_notification (GHSA-xrmj-5g4g-8987)
summary: @dynatrace-oss/dynatrace-mcp-server before 2.0.0 interpolates three caller-supplied parameters (teamName, problemType, channel) of the create_workflow_for_notification tool directly into a Dynatrace Workflow definition. Dynatrace Workflows evaluate Jinja2 {{ ... }} expressions in action inputs at runtime, so injected expressions (e.g. {{ event() }}) can exfiltrate event data to attacker-controlled destinations through a workflow that persists in the tenant after the MCP session ends. Fixed in 2.0.0 (PR #547).
